parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: Identifies the source of the location data.

parameters.name: AcquiredTime
parameters.description: The time when the location was acquired.

parameters.name: ExternalSource
parameters.description: URL, MAC address, or other identifier that identifies an "External" source of this location. Meaningful only if {{param|Source}} has a value of {{enum|External|Source}}, otherwise it MUST be {{empty}}. If {{param|ExternalProtocol}} has a value of {{enum|CWMP|ExternalProtocol}}, this is the URL or IP address of the Controller.

parameters.name: ExternalProtocol
parameters.description: Protocol used to acquire a location from an "External" source. {{enum}} Meaningful only if {{param|Source}} has a value of {{enum|External|Source}}, otherwise it MUST be {{empty}}.

parameters.name: DataObject
parameters.description: The currently valid location information. Writable only when {{param|ExternalProtocol}} has a value of {{enum|CWMP|ExternalProtocol}} or {{enum|USP|ExternalProtocol}}. If obtained through the local GPS/AGPS then the location information is formatted according to {{bibref|RFC5491}}. If manually configured then location information will be XML-formatted according to {{bibref|RFC5491}} (geographical information) and {{bibref|RFC5139}} (civic addresses). If obtained by an external source this is the location information as received. If it's an XML document (e.g. CWMP, OMA-DM, UPnP, HELD, MLP) the location information will be represented as-is, otherwise it will be converted to base64. CWMP or USP configured location information will be XML-formatted according to {{bibref|RFC5491}} (geographical information) and {{bibref|RFC5139}} (civic addresses). Only zero or one Location object instance with value {{enum|CWMP|ExternalProtocol}} or {{enum|USP|ExternalProtocol}} MUST exist at any given time.
